questions.question_text: Was a firearm, taser, gun, rifle, or other weapon visibly present during the incident? If so, when?
Was anyone visibly injured or bleeding during the incident? If so, when?
Did any officer provide visible medical assistance? If so, when?
When did an officer use or attempt to use handcuffs?
Did the use or attempted use of handcuffs occur before or after visible medical assistance?
